name: Cross
description: CROSS is the token of ONEchain, a gaming-optimized Layer 1 blockchain that gives players true ownership of in-game assets through a decentralized, EVM-compatible infrastructure. It provides a modular development framework with SDKs, APIs, and smart contract templates to simplify blockchain integration for game studios, and uses high-performance Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) consensus capable of over 5,000 transactions per second with near-instant finality.
